### Problem

What are you trying to do, and what currently prevents it?

### Proposed behavior

Show the desired behavior or API and any alternatives you considered.

### Protocol evidence

For provider support, link official signing documentation and identify the
webhook mode. Use synthetic examples; do not include account credentials.

### Acceptance

What test or example would demonstrate that this solves the problem?
